pack.name: The Fighting Pit
pack.summary: The chain example. A fighting pit in play: win a bout and a stronger challenger comes the next season. Each win draws a crowd and pays.

tags.meaning: The pit's fighter won a bout this season. The town talks of nothing else.

things.name: Fighting pit
things.text: A ring of stakes and sand. It costs 1 Materials each season.
things.art: A torch-lit ring of stakes with a crowd on the rails, painterly.

cards.title: Dig a fighting pit
cards.pitch: Give me 1 worker and 2 Materials and I will dig a pit below the old dam. Fighters will come.

if_taken.say: The pit is dug. A first challenger is on the road.

if_expires.say: The pit master moves on to the next town.

cards.art: A broad man with a spade marking a circle in the dirt, painterly.

cards.title: A drover calls out your fighter
cards.pitch: A drover says he can beat any man here. Put your fighter in.

success.say: Your fighter wins. The crowd pays in.

failure.say: Your fighter is beaten. The town is sore about it.

cards.art: Two men circling in a sand ring, painterly.

cards.title: Two caravan guards call you out
cards.pitch: Word got round. Two caravan guards want the pit.

success.say: Both guards go down. The purse is yours.

failure.say: The guards win and take the purse.

cards.art: Two armoured guards stepping over the pit rail, painterly.

cards.title: The Red Wolf and his crew call you out
cards.pitch: The Red Wolf has come with three of his crew. Nobody has beaten them.

success.say: The Red Wolf yields. He and his crew sign on with you.

failure.say: The crew wreck the pit and fire the sheds by the dam.

if_expires.say: The Red Wolf spits and rides on.

cards.art: A scarred man in a red cloak with three fighters behind him, painterly.

cards.title: An open bout at the pit
cards.pitch: Since the Red Wolf fell, hopefuls turn up every season. Each time your champion wins, more of them come.

success.say: Your champion sends the hopefuls home.

failure.say: Your champion is beaten. The run of wins is over.

cards.art: Two young fighters at the pit rail at dawn, painterly.

cards.title: A hedge witch sells red mist
cards.pitch: A pinch of red mist in a fighter's face and he sees only enemies. His own friends too. 2 Materials.

if_taken.say: You can cast Red mist into a bout now.

if_expires.say: The hedge witch takes her mist to the next fair.

cards.art: An old woman holding a pouch of red dust over a sand ring, painterly.

cards.title: A hedge witch sells a veil
cards.pitch: Throw this veil over your fighter and nobody can see him to hit him. 2 Materials.

if_taken.say: You can cast the Veil into a bout now.

if_expires.say: The hedge witch folds up her veil and leaves.

cards.art: An old woman shaking out a grey veil that fades into the air, painterly.

abilities.name: Red mist
abilities.text: Cast it on the challengers. Those within 8 paces turn on anyone near them, one another too.
abilities.look: a red haze over the fighters' heads

abilities.name: Veil
abilities.text: Cast it on your fighter. Your people within 6 paces vanish. No challenger can find them to hit them.

rules.name: Word of the pit
rules.why: a drover heard of {a} and came to fight

rules.name: A name to beat
rules.why: your fighter's win at {a} brought harder men

rules.name: The Red Wolf hears
rules.why: two wins at {a} reached the Red Wolf

rules.name: Talk of the town
rules.why: the win made {a} the talk of the town

rules.name: Wagers on the champion
rules.why: the shrine took its tithe of the wagers at {a}: +{n} Magic

rules.name: The pit crowd comes to the parade
rules.why: the champion of {a} walked in the parade and {n} more people came out

rules.name: The pit never sleeps
rules.why: with the Red Wolf beaten, hopefuls line up at {a}

rules.name: Win and they come again
rules.why: another win at {a}, another pair of hopefuls

rules.name: Word spreads
rules.why: another win at {a}: the next hopefuls bring a friend

rules.name: Pit drums in the parade
rules.why: the drums of {a} led the parade and {n} more people came out

rules.name: A hat passed round
rules.why: the pit's hat went round the parade crowd: +{n} Materials

events.title: An open bout
events.how: Your champion meets the hopefuls. He can beat one. Cast spells to put the others down.

events.title: The drover's bout
events.how: Your fighter meets the drover in the pit.

events.title: The guards' bout
events.how: Your fighter meets two caravan guards. He can beat one. Cast a spell to put the other down.

events.title: The Red Wolf's bout
events.how: Your fighter meets the Red Wolf and three of his crew. He can beat one. Cast spells to put the others down.

wants: A fighter as a thing with strength a rule can raise, so wins make later bouts easier without spells.
